meta.title: Fix quantifier weight default to prevent performance regression
meta.body_summary: Fix performance regression in quantifier instantiation by changing the default quantifier weight from 0 to 1, enabling matching loop detection and preventing infinite instantiation.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot changed default quantifier weight from 0 to 1 to prevent infinite instantiation; no formal review; one comment noting an older Z3 version also efficient; closed after 11 days without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 23 changed lines, this is a tiny change by absolute volume. It fits a small-scope performance fix that might have merged easily, but it was closed without merge—likely due to lack of maintainer engagement or uncertainty about the fix's necessity.

review_details.concern_detail: A single comment from rod-chapman notes that Z3 4.12.6 also proves the file efficiently, implying doubt about whether the weight default change is the correct or sufficient fix for the reported regression.
review_details.performance_claim: Changing default quantifier weight from 0 to 1 prevents infinite instantiation and performance blowup.
review_details.rejection_signals: No formal review; one comment questioning fix necessity; closed with no follow-up discussion or evidence.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A tiny solver engine parameter change was submitted by an agent; without maintainer engagement or performance evidence, the PR was closed after 11 days. This illustrates a process boundary where agent-authored PRs may be ignored if reviewers do not actively engage.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body provides a logical explanation and a test case, but no benchmark, profiling data, or before/after timing results.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge after 11 days with no changes or further discussion.

core_change_summary.description: Changed the default weight parameter from 0 to 1 in mk_quantifier, mk_forall, and mk_exists function declarations in src/ast/ast.h to re-enable matching loop detection and prevent infinite instantiation.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: A minimal SMT2 test case was added to verify the fix.
change_trajectory: Commit modifying the default weight values in ast.h.
Commit adding a test case in examples/test_quantifier_weight_fix.smt2.

review_signals.summary: Z3 4.12.6 also proves this file efficiently, implying the regression may not exist in that version or the fix may be unnecessary.

rod-chapman commented that an older Z3 version also runs efficiently, raising doubt about the fix.
No maintainer review or response; PR closed by maintainer after 11 days of inactivity.
